messages.subject: Harcourt DPO review – Data Processing Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

I've reviewed the DPA. Two points before sign-off:

1. Breach notification – please confirm 48 hours from awareness (Annex says this, just confirming it's firm).
2. Sub-processors – we need the right to object to new sub-processors; the 14-day objection window is acceptable.

Otherwise content. The TOMs in Annex 2 (ISO 27001, AES-256, MFA) meet our requirements.

Sandra Whitcombe | Data Protection Officer | Harcourt Beverages
